limitations: Live evidence is operation- and scope-specific; it does not imply full container access.
Core release-candidate acceptance is complete for the enabled metadata-only web-user surface.
The release-acceptance profiles authorized no record types, queryable fields, or payload fields, so query and payload paths were not live exercised and no private selector was inferred.
The public API-token live check proves the documented authentication challenge, not authenticated public database access.
Server-key signing is implemented and synthetically verified but has not been live verified.
Deliberate live account-switch and expiry cases were not performed because they require human reauthentication; their fail-closed behavior is covered synthetically.
Query wire behavior and provider error/retry variants have no live-verified scope.
Canonical live share inspection returned unavailable through both verified views; topology availability is not claimed.
Change feeds have live evidence in shared scope; private-scope change behavior remains live-unverified.
Shared-zone listing and lookup remain disabled until separately live verified.
Shared subscription listing remains disabled until separately live verified.
Authentication login/callback automation is not implemented; auth import accepts an already-acquired token through a hidden terminal prompt.
App-local CKSyncEngine state, upload queues, notification delivery, mutation, invitation acceptance, and asset downloads are unavailable.
